$comment: Bounded tile pyramid for the location map, centred on profile.location. The map's view is pinned to the location (no dragging, and every zoom gesture keeps the centre fixed), so `window` only has to cover what Leaflet loads: the card plus the half-screen buffer it keeps on each side, and it shrinks geographically as you zoom in. `viewport` is the largest the card ever gets, from .basic-info-container's max-width — the script refuses to build if `window` is too small to cover it. `retina: true` additionally emits @2x tiles and makes the map request them (roughly 2.5x the bytes).
